name: Dual Contouring with Root Finding and Analytic Normals
aliases: Dual contouring with root finding and analytic normals
definition: A dual contouring variant that improves feature crispness by using root finding to locate exact surface crossings on edges and computing normals analytically at those points, rather than interpolating or using grid-based approximations.
summary: Dual Contouring with Root Finding and Analytic Normals improves feature crispness by locating exact surface crossings via root finding and computing normals analytically from brush points.
